When the LED Lighting measure is added into the package, we see additional utility bill savings nationally. The utility bill savings are seen only in electricity bills, which is a result of replacing lighting with more efficient LEDs. The natural gas and other fuel bills do not change substantially at the stock level, indicating that the internal load reductions from the LED lights have minimal effect on natural gas bills. Individual buildings or smaller geographic regions could see changes in natural gas, propane, or fuel oil bills (due to changes in HVAC load when installing more efficient lighting with lower internal gains).
